bias.zh: 偏空 · 测试 200 日均线后守住 $230

read.en: Bloom Energy slipped 1.3% on Oct 15 to $236.30 off an intraday low of $215.12, and is down 13% in five sessions. It is below its 5-day ($256.4), 10-day ($271.8), 30-day ($270.3) and falling 100-day ($252.6) averages and above the 200-day ($215.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8 and is just above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($291.3), and RSI is 40.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 10月15日盘中下探 $215.12 后回升，小幅下跌 1.3%，收于 $236.30，五个交易日下跌 13%。股价位于 5 日（$256.4）、10 日（$271.8）、30 日（$270.3）和下行的 100 日均线（$252.6）下方，并在 200 日均线（$215.6）上方。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线下方，仅略高于零轴，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$291.3），RSI 为 40。

read.en: No level broke: the day's low tested the 200-day average ($215.6) and the stock closed back above the $230 June pivot. Resistance is $248–253 (Oct 13 low and 100-day average), then $256 (5-day) and $270–272 (30 and 10-day averages). Support is $230, then $215 (200-day) and $197.5 (Sep 1 low). A close above $253 would open $270; a close below $230 would open $215.
read.zh: 收盘未跌破任何关键位：当日低点测试 200 日均线（$215.6），随后收回 $230 的 6月转折点上方。阻力为 $248–253（10月13日低点及 100 日均线），其次 $256（5 日均线）和 $270–272（30 日和 10 日均线）。支撑为 $230，其次 $215（200 日均线）和 $197.5（9月1日低点）。若收盘站上 $253，将打开至 $270 的空间；若收盘跌破 $230，下一目标看 $215。

r.en: Old $252 support, Oct 13 low and 100-day average ($248–253)
